status_summary: No creation of a stand-alone American Indian Office was found. EPA's organization chart, updated 2026-09-09, still lists the combined Office of International and Tribal Affairs and no separate tribal office. The nominee for Assistant Administrator of that combined office testified before the Senate Environment and Public Works Committee on 2025-06-25, and EPA announced her confirmation on 2025-10-07. In 2026 the American Indian Environmental Office, within the combined office, was running a review of EPA's tribal partnership network, with listening sessions, without announcing a reorganization. The document's related call to restructure the combined office is also tracked in c13-04.
